horizonSource: checkpoint.json params.label_horizon_bars (bars on the raw grid)
labelDefinition: triple-barrier direction over the next 5 bars with a 5.0 basis-point barrier (src/ml/xgb_classifier/labels.py); 1 = up barrier touched first

cost.source: recovered from this model's 78 recorded trades (gross from the lake's closes minus each recorded net): 2.80 US dollars per round trip

interval.method: causal conformal: probability_up binned into trailing deciles, empirical quantiles of realized forward return per bin, refreshed on a fixed step using only rows whose horizon has already elapsed

attribution.method: TreeSHAP over the validation rows (xgboost pred_contribs), re-aligned to bar order through shap_summary.npz sample_indices

verification.measured: 350 of 350 predictions sit on a lake bar at the same second
verification.expected: every prediction sits on a lake bar

verification.name: stored_realized_returns_reproduced_by_lake_closes
verification.measured: largest difference 4.636e-05 basis points over 350 rows

verification.name: replayed_trade_count_matches_model_diagnostics
verification.measured: 78 trades replayed on the bar grid

verification.name: one_round_trip_cost_explains_every_recorded_trade

verification.name: price_bars_well_formed

verification.name: interval_has_no_lookahead

verification.expected: the first moved row is after 208 — a mapping calibrated on the whole record fails this

notes: Prices are read from the lake on the model's own bar grid. Its evaluator stepped 5 BARS ahead, not 5 rows: this record is the 427 lake bars from the first prediction to 5 bars past the last, 350 of which carry a prediction. A bar with no prediction (its label was dropped in training) carries no probability, label or realized return and never trades, exactly as in the model's own evaluation.
The lake reproduces every stored realized return to 4.6e-05 basis points.
This record was scored at 1.40 points per round trip, recovered from its own trades; src/config/cost_model.json now prices MNQ at 1.39 points. The lens charges what the model's evaluator charged.
The row-by-row price reconstruction does not apply to this record: replayed 68 trades but the model's diagnostics record 78 — the trade rule in this lens does not match the one that produced them.

Feature VALUES are not recoverable for this model (the artifact stores attributions only, and the lake no longer reproduces its inputs), so the playback shows each feature's contribution without the value it was computed from.
